map.公式：每日总剂量 = 体重 x 推荐剂量；每次剂量 = 每日总剂量 / 服药频率: Formula: total daily dose = body weight x recommended dose; dose per administration = total daily dose / dosing frequency. The results are for reference only; follow your doctor's instructions.
map.公式：每分钟滴数 = (输液总量 x 滴系数) / 输液时间(分钟)；每小时毫升: Formula: drops per minute = (total volume x drop factor) / infusion time (minutes); ml per hour = total volume / (infusion time/60).
map.换算系数：mmol/L × 18.0159 = mg/dL。参考值基于 WHO: Conversion factor: mmol/L × 18.0159 = mg/dL. Reference values follow the WHO diabetes diagnostic criteria; please follow your doctor's instructions for a definitive diagnosis.
map.正常体温范围 36.0 - 37.2℃。绿色区域为正常范围，红色虚线标记发热阈值: The normal body temperature range is 36.0 - 37.2℃. The green area is the normal range and the red dashed line marks the fever threshold (37.3℃). Data is stored locally in the browser.

map.分类标准：当收缩压与舒张压分属不同级别时，以较高的级别为准。单纯收缩期高血压为收: Classification rule: when systolic and diastolic pressure fall into different grades, the higher grade applies. Isolated systolic hypertension is elevated systolic pressure with diastolic < 90 mmHg.

map.①剂量：每日总剂量 = 体重(kg) × 每公斤剂量(mg/kg)，每次剂量 =: ①Dosage: total daily dose = body weight (kg) × dose per kg (mg/kg), dose per administration = total daily dose ÷ doses per day. ②Infusion: drops/min = volume (mL) × drop factor ÷ time (min), drops/hour = drops/min × 60, mL/h = volume ÷ (time ÷ 60). ③Blood glucose: mg/dL = mmol/L × 18.0159, mmol/L = mg/dL ÷ 18.0159 (the tool embeds the exact factor, unlike the generic conversion page which uses the approximation 18).
map.剂量模块：60 kg、10 mg/kg、每日 3 次 → 每日总剂量 600.0: Dosage module: 60 kg, 10 mg/kg, 3 times per day → total daily dose 600.0 mg, 200.0 mg per dose (default parameters). Infusion module: 500 mL, 120 minutes, drop factor 15 → drops/min = 500 × 15 ÷ 120 = 62.5 ≈ 63 drops/min, drops/hour = 3750, mL/h = 500 ÷ 2 = 250.0. Blood glucose module: 5.6 mmol/L × 18.0159 ≈ 100.9 mg/dL (this is exactly the page default), and in reverse 100.9 ÷ 18.0159 ≈ 5.60 mmol/L.
map.「每日总剂量 ÷ 次数」和「每次剂量 × 次数」哪种算法对？: Is "total daily dose ÷ doses" or "dose per administration × doses" correct?
map.取决于医嘱的表述方式。若医嘱为「每日 10 mg/kg，分 3 次」，应先算日总: It depends on how the doctor's order is worded. If the order reads "10 mg/kg per day, divided into 3 doses", compute the daily total first and then divide it equally (this is the path the tool uses); if it reads "10 mg/kg per dose, 3 times per day", the daily total is 3 times the per-dose amount. The two differ by a factor of 3, which is the most common source of dosing errors, so always pick the method that matches the wording of the order — this matters especially in paediatrics.
map.滴/分取整后误差有多大？: How large is the error after rounding drops per minute to an integer?
map.本例理论值 62.5 滴/分取整为 63，相对误差 0.8%。实际重力滴注中液面: The theoretical 62.5 drops/min rounds to 63, a relative error of 0.8%. In real gravity drip the deviations from fluid level height, line kinks and patient position are far larger (often ±10%), so the drop count is used to set an initial value, after which the actual rate is fine-tuned and reviewed periodically; narrow therapeutic index drugs should use an infusion pump.
